top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver gave a toddler Mike and Ike candy which can be a choking hazard for that age group. The caregiver no longer works at the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Corrections Made to Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The deficiencies in the Fire Marshal inspection report from 9/24/2024 have not been corrected.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The immunization record for one child was not up to date.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance (26 TAC §747.801(14))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's record did not contain parental notification of lack of liability insurance.
